positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Software Engineering Intern for Enterprise Infrastructure

Built a lightweight and efficient logging API supporting up to 50,000 log messages per second for enterprise applications. (Java)
Built a full-text search application to support rapid search and filtering of log messages provided by a Solr service. (Ember.js)
Collaborated with chief systems architect to redesign the way log messages are created, stored and searched.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Web Developer Intern for the CIPRES Science Gateway Project

Evaluated and provided feedback on development of CIPRES REST API.
Created sample consumer application for CIPRES REST API. (HTML/CSS, Ember.js)
Wrote script for parsing and conversion of an XML file into an HTML form. (jQuery)

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
IT Intern for Advanced Billing Solutions

Enhanced UI design of internal web application supporting over 1000 employees. (HTML/CSS, jQuery)
Consulted with stakeholders in order to produce mockups for future enhancements of internal web application. (HTML/CSS)

projects.title: Battlemates
projects.description: Designing a turn-based multiplayer game where players use their Facebook friends to battle with each other. Application follows a client-server architecture using an Ember.js client, and a server implemented using Node.js/Express, MongoDB/Mongoose and Socket.io.

projects.title: Member Management App
projects.description: Web application facilitating student sign-in at events through use of card reader. Records member involvement trends and event statistics. Programmed middle-end functionality for user authentication and authorization, Ajax data transport and URL routing. (Ember.js, jQuery)
